facts.business: Katare Spinning Mills Limited operates a spinning mill and a 1 MW captive solar power plant for manufacturing operations.

auditor.name: Not stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to inability to evaluate Net Deferred Tax Liability (Rs. 78.87 lakh) and potential impairment of Property, Plant & Equipment under Ind AS 36 given prolonged non-operational status of spinning division. Material uncertainty related to going concern highlighted but opinion not modified on that basis.

key_risks: Prolonged non-operational status of spinning division
Continuous net losses and accumulated losses (Net loss Rs. 2.16 crore in FY26)
Material uncertainty related to going concern
Regulatory changes in MERC framework affecting solar power economics
Volatility in cotton prices and yarn realizations
Subdued market demand and pressure on operating margins
Non-recognition of Deferred Tax Assets on carried forward losses due to lack of virtual certainty
No impairment testing completed on Property, Plant & Equipment under Ind AS 36
